title: Testing Equality of Distributions via Repeatedly Integrated Quantile Metrics Under Weak Moment Conditions
summary: Testing whether two independent samples arise from the same underlying distribution is a fundamental statistical problem. We propose a new class of two-sample distribution tests based on a family of probability metrics $Δ_{n,p}$, constructed from repeatedly integrated quantile functions. On their respective domains, these metrics are proved to be genuine distributional distances. The case $n=1$ recovers the $p$-Wasserstein distance, which requires finite $p$-th moments; for $n\geq2$, the proposed metrics are well defined and require only finite first moments.
